capabilities: Render ordered heading numbers (1., 1.1, 1.1.1) in Live Preview, Reading view and the outline
Style nested lists, quotes, callouts and completed tasks
Resize table columns by dragging header boundaries
Drag images into rows and add editable captions stored beside the embeds
Record each note's creation time in a created frontmatter property, with bulk-fill commands
disambiguation: Not a Feishu/Lark integration; it only styles local Markdown notes to look like Feishu documents.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states it is unaffiliated with Feishu, Lark or Obsidian, MIT-licensed, and that mobile and non-default themes are unverified.
intentEvidence: Inspired by Feishu/Lark, with support for Live Preview and Reading view.
motivation: Inspired by Feishu/Lark documents, to give Markdown notes the clarity of a document in Live Preview and Reading view.
problem: Obsidian's default rendering gives headings, lists, tables and images little visual hierarchy and no way to lay images out in rows with captions.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Feishu/Lark, with support for Live Preview and Reading view.
Verified on macOS with Obsidian 1.12.7 and Minimal

summary: Layout and styling plugin that renders notes like Feishu/Lark documents, with ordered headings, nested list markers, resizable tables and image rows with captions.
